text: Joe Sellors, Project Manager, Economic Development and Culture, will give a presentation on Toronto’s Year of Public Art 2021 - and provide an update on projects that will acknowledge the Indigenous history, present and future of the land they are situated on; self-determination, freedom of expression, equitable access to resources, and greater influence over public art practices; and that Indigenous communities and creators must be at the centre of the decision-making process for any Indigenous-focused project.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee received the item for information.
